title: Crispy Teriyaki Tofu with Bok Choy
description: Golden pan-fried tofu glazed in a quick homemade teriyaki sauce, with seared baby bok choy.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then bring it to a boil with 2¼ cups water and a pinch of salt. Cover, turn the heat to low and cook until the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Let it stand off the heat, still covered, while you cook.
Pat the tofu very dry, cut it into 1-inch cubes and toss with 1½ tbsp of the cornstarch.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on most sides, 8 to 10 minutes. Move to a plate.
Whisk the soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, garlic, ginger, the remaining cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Add the remaining oil and place the bok choy cut-side down. Sear until browned, about 2 minutes, then flip, add a splash of water, cover and steam for 2 minutes.
Return the tofu, pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy, about 1 minute. Serve over the rice with sesame seeds.
